scope_refinement.deviation_from_plan: EXTERNAL_EVALUATION_PLAN.md lists exclusions for the other services plus node_modules/dist/bin/obj/.git and states that tests, Dockerfiles, project files and config files inside the selected services must not be excluded. It does not mention generated protobuf bindings.
scope_refinement.decision: The two genproto directories are additionally excluded. They are generated protobuf/gRPC bindings with explicit DO-NOT-EDIT markers and account for 7578 of the 9696 in-scope C#/Go lines, leaving 2118 hand-written lines.
scope_refinement.justification: The plan's own selection principle is that a case must stay small enough for a person to independently review complete gold annotations. Including generated bindings would add thousands of machine-emitted type and method declarations that carry no documentation meaning, and the detector's data_contract rule matches Go 'type X struct' so they would also dominate the measured denominator.
scope_refinement.effect_on_measurement: Both the gold set and the deterministic detector denominator are computed over the same reduced scope, so precision and recall remain comparable. Tests, Dockerfiles, project files and config files inside the three services are retained as the plan requires.
